claim_text: The National Hurricane Center issued a rare hurricane warning for Hawaii's Big Island on Saturday 15 August 2026, where a landfall would have been the first in 155 years, with forecasters predicting up to 25 inches of rain at higher elevations.
quote: The National Hurricane Center issued a rare hurricane warning for the island, where it would be the first to make landfall in 155 years.
confidence_justification: Warning issuance is an official NHC action; the 25-inch rainfall forecast appears in the same article.
